players.bio: Ali Ahmed (born October 10, 2000) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a wide midfielder or winger for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Canada national team. Ahmed was born in Toronto to Ethiopian parents.

Andre Brooks is a 22-year-old professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Norwich City in the EFL Championship and represents the Jamaica national football team internationally. Born in Sheffield, Brooks joined the youth academy of Sheffield United at the age of 8.

Anis Ben Slimane (born 16 March 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City. Born in Denmark, he plays for the Tunisia national team. Ben Slimane had a tumultuous youth career, playing for eight different clubs in twelve years, but finally settled at AB where he made his senior debut in 2018.
Ante Crnac (born 17 December 2003) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City.
Anthony Tite Emmanuel Musaba is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Norwich City, on loan from Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe.

Benjamin Joshua Chrisene (born 12 January 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Norwich City. He is a product of the Exeter City academy and made five first-team appearances during the 2019–20 season, at the age of fifteen.
Bruno Ferreira Alves (born 4 August 2005) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defender for club Norwich City, on loan from Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Cruzeiro.

Daniel James Grimshaw (born 16 January 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for club Norwich City. He has previously played for Manchester City, Hemel Hempstead Town, Lommel, Blackpool and Plymouth Argyle. Club career Born in Salford, Grimshaw joined his local club Manchester City as a teenager. In June 2018, he signed a new three-year deal with the club.
Darlin Zidane Yongwa Ngameni (born 22 September 2000) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Cameroon national team.
Gabriel Kevin Forsyth (born 4 August 2006) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City.
Harry Jack Darling (born 8 August 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Norwich City .

Jack William Stacey (born 6 April 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender or a midfielder for Championship club Norwich City. Stacey joined the Royals Academy as a 8-year-old in 2004, going on to sign his first professional contract with the club in December 2013, on a contract going through to the end of the 2015–16 season.

Jacob Anthony Wright (born 21 September 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder . Wright played for the Manchester City academy in the 2023–24 EFL Trophy. He was also included in the Manchester City senior squad that travelled to Saudi Arabia to play in the 2023 FIFA Club World Cup.
José Ángel Córdoba Chambers (born 3 June 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Panama national team.
Jovon Willesley Makama is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Norwich City.

Kellen Fisher (born 5 May 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Championship club Norwich City. In June 2023, Fisher joined Championship side Norwich City on a long-term deal.

Kenneth McLean (born 8 January 1992) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder or left midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Scotland national team. After being released by Rangers' youth team, McLean started his senior career at SPL club St Mirren.
Liam Geoffrey Gibbs is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Preston North End on loan from EFL Championship club Norwich City.
Lucien Denhere Patrick Java Mahovo is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Norwich City.

Matěj Jurásek is a Czech professional football player who plays as a right winger for Czech First League club Sparta Prague, on loan from EFL Championship club Norwich City, and the Czech Republic national team.

Mathias Damm Kvistgaarden (born 15 April 2002) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Denmark national team. He has represented Denmark at youth level. Kvistgaarden has won six caps for Denmark at under-18 level in which he has scored three goals.
Mirko Topić (born 5 February 2001) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Serbia national team.
Mohamed "Mo" Touré (born 26 March 2004) is a professional soccer player who plays as a striker for Norwich City. Born a Liberian refugee in Guinea, he plays for the Australia national team.
Oscar Schwartau (born 17 May 2006) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City. He has represented Denmark at youth levels.

Papa Amadou Diallo (born 25 June 2004) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Norwich City. Club career In February 2023, Diallo signed for French side Metz. He made his Ligue 1 debut for Metz on 3 September 2023 against Reims. International career Youth Diallo was called up to the Senegalese under-20 side for the 2023 Africa U-20 Cup of Nations.

Edmond-Paris Maghoma (born 8 May 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City. He is a product of the Tottenham Hotspur academy and was capped by England at youth level.
Pelle Elkjær Mattsson is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City.

Philippe Clement (born 22 March 1974) is a Belgian professional football manager and former player who is the head coach of EFL Championship club Norwich City. He began his professional career at Belgian clubs Beerschot and Genk between 1992 and 1998, thereafter he joined Coventry City in England for one season.
Ruairi McConville (born 1 May 2005) is a Northern Irish footballer who plays as a centre-back or right-back for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Northern Ireland national team.
Samuel Edward Field is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Norwich City.

Vicente Phillip Reyes Núñez (born 19 November 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Norwich City. Born in the United States, he represents Chile at youth level.

Vladan Kovačević is a Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Norwich City. Kovačević started his professional career at Sarajevo, who loaned him to Sloboda Mrkonjić Grad in 2018.
